quote: Inert diluents affect the cool-flame-supported n-alkane droplet combustion substantially, through heat-transfer and diffusion processes, and not by influencing chemical-kinetic rates.
subject: Cool-flame droplets: the inert gas matters through heat transfer and diffusion, not chemical kinetics

quote: A simplified, quasi-steady theory can be used to predict the burning rates and to a large extent extinction diameters when thermodynamic and transport properties are selected appropriately. A recipe for such selection is presented here.
subject: A simple quasi-steady theory predicts cool-flame burning rates and, largely, extinction diameters

quote: Extinction-diameter correlations suggest that the currently available chemical-kinetic descriptions are adequate for lower normal alkanes, while further study is needed for higher alkanes.
subject: Chemical-kinetic models are adequate for lower n-alkanes; higher alkanes need more study

quote: Xenon decreases burning rates substantially, but can sustain cool flames at much lower oxygen concentrations compared to helium.
subject: Xenon slows burning but sustains cool flames at much lower oxygen than helium
